explication: Toxiproxy is a TCP proxy for deterministic or randomized network fault simulation. Applications route test connections through its proxies; users configure proxy mappings and inject or update toxics through the HTTP API or Go client/CLI, then exercise the resulting degraded connections. The runtime path runs from API-managed proxy state through TCP connection handling into directional toxic chains and back to the upstream or client. The README also documents latency, outages, bandwidth limits, packet loss, slicing, timeouts, and related toxic behaviors. Unsampled handlers and proxy internals are represented only where README or excerpts support their role.
